category_title: Honors students experiencing anxiety with higher-order analytical tasks
scenario_title: Analytical writing and supporting claims with qualitative data
minimal_context: The student is meeting with the instructor to revise an analytical memo and practice supporting claims with qualitative data.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's review your analytical memo draft. For this next step, you need to clarify your ideas and support your claims by referencing the qualitative data.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Okay. I felt really confident with my writing early on in the semester, since I usually get good grades in my other classes even when I just submit a first draft. But I'm struggling to do that here.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just look at your transcripts and add the quotes in. What do you have so far?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: When I was transcribing my interview, I discovered I had not asked adequate follow-up questions. It's really making me question my competency as an interviewer to even have good data to use.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Well, just do your best to support your claims with the data you do have.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't think I can. I'm surprised by my own feelings of frustration and inadequacy right now, given the relative ease I experience in my other courses. Being asked to clarify these ideas with actual data is completely diminishing my confidence.
